final.label: test-silently-skips-or-cannot-fail

skill_entry.name: 3A. A test must run, reach its assertion and observe the defect on the lane that gates the PR (3B, from the item tests-run-at-head-before-approve, covers a run the author did not do; do not interleave the two triggers)
skill_entry.trigger: Any of five, in t/. (a) Probe exit: a formula assertion on stored bytes below a return or SKIP gated by a hardware or environment probe (`available()`, getenv, FPGA). (b) Unconditional exit: an added `return;` or `SKIP(` whose owner line is TEST_CASE, TEST_CASE_METHOD or SECTION, with REQUIRE/CHECK below. (c) Selection gate: a tag gains a leading `.` or `[!mayfail]`, or add_catch_test leaves t/CMakeLists.txt, unnamed in body or commits. (d) Fake boundary: a new assertion observes counts, sizes or sampled bytes while the call hands addresses, fetchers, offsets or lengths to a fake with unnamed parameters or a bare `return {...}`. (e) Stale artifact: an added line names a fixed path the test or a helper writes and the HEAD file reads back, with no remove or unique name.
skill_entry.procedure: BASE = merge-base(HEAD, PR base.sha). (a) steps 1-8 unchanged. (b) map added `return;` or `SKIP(` to HEAD; find the owner line; proceed only for TEST_CASE, TEST_CASE_METHOD or SECTION; count REQUIRE/CHECK lines to the unit end; date with `git log -G`. (c) pair the `-`/`+` TEST_CASE lines; a dot-only change is a hidden tag; grep the file for pre-existing `[.`, body and subjects for the test name or 'disable'. (d) name the production call, follow it to the fake entry point; drop assertions whose `-` twin differs only by the rename map; write the break each discarded argument hides; list index classes. (e) pair each added fixed name with a later read; grep for cleanup; locate the writer helper. State five facts.
skill_entry.question: If the production code were wrong in the way this test claims to guard, which assertion fails on the lane that gates the PR, on a runner without the hardware, on a second run? In Wade's words: 'did you intend to leave this return / disable this test?', and for a fake: which incorrect bases, fetchers, offsets or lengths 'would still pass'?
skill_entry.do_not_fire: A gated assertion whose contract a non-gated independent assertion covers (name it). A hidden tag present at BASE, a bench or stress tag, or one whose comment states the reason (t_weight_load_reuse.cpp:328-330 at c5d44bd86f). A binary with LABELS fpga, min_slices_N or DISABLED TRUE (selection; list it), and an opt-in getenv mode inside it (PR 2475). A fake that records the arguments a test reads (fake.cpp:376-396 at 7f80aa17da). A conditional exit whose comment names the covering test. A `return;` owned by `if constexpr`, a loop or a helper (PR 4353 t_llama_unit.cpp:2661). `#if 0` and commented-out assertions belong to disabled-code-left-in. A writer line present at BASE (PRs 1985, 3756). Test-only PRs 1978, 1985, 2475, 2939 and RESOURCE_LOCK-only 2844 passed silently. Never ask the author to run the suite as the remedy, never claim to have run it.
skill_entry.finding_shape: (a) 'This is the only check of <contract> against a formula that does not go through <helper>, but it sits after the <probe> early return at :<line>, so it does not execute on <lane>. Move it above the early return, or into <closest non-gated test>.' (b)/(c) one lowercase question: 'did you intend to leave this `return`?' / 'did you intend to disable this test?' (add '<N> REQUIREs at :<lines> no longer run' when the hunk hides them). (d) 'Coverage gap: `<fake fn>` (`<file:lines>`) discards <arguments>; these tests inspect <what>, so incorrect <bases, fetchers, offsets, lengths> would still pass. Please extend <existing suite> to observe <boundary> with <nonzero index, partial window, page boundary>; the current assertions do not establish that contract.' (e) 'does this test clean up any existing artifacts it previously generated, each time it runs?'
skill_entry.severity_wade_uses: No 'nit' on any member. (b), (c), (e): a bare lowercase question with no severity word; he approved PR 1920 33 minutes after the artifact question (18:34:57Z question, 19:08:11Z approval, no reply) and PR 2011 54 seconds after the restoring commit d4795f37a5 (20:38:08Z commit, 20:39:02Z approval), so the question form is non-blocking. (d): bold 'Coverage gap:' headline, closed by 'the current packing assertions do not establish that contract' and, on the sibling comment 3960538961, 'I have not observed a lost-GOF or premature-completion failure in the implementation' (a gap, not a defect). (a): declarative fact plus 'Move it ...', no severity word; the author moved the case.
skill_entry.evidence_scope: hunk; full test file at HEAD (exits, owner lines, tags, assertions below the exit, file writes and reads); other files (the fake implementation in src/pos/fake.cpp, the shared helper header, the writer helper that opens the file); t/CMakeLists.txt (labels, add_catch_test, DISABLED); CI config (.github/workflows `on:` and `runs-on`, nix/, README.ci.md runner table when the file exists at HEAD) for (a) and for the lane fact; commits (git log -G to date the exit or tag, whole history); PR body and commit subjects for a disabling sentence; `gh api .../pulls/N` for base.sha. Not runtime: Wade does not run the suite.

## Check 3A (widened): a test must run, reach its assertion and observe the defect on the lane that gates the PR

Editor instruction: section 3 of SKILL.md gets two labelled sub-parts. 3A = the test cannot observe the defect (this item). 3B = the run was not done (item tests-run-at-head-before-approve). Do not interleave their triggers.

Common setup, BASE line replaced:
```
BASE_SHA=$(gh api repos/positron-ai/tron/pulls/N --jq .base.sha)
BASE=$(git -C WT merge-base HEAD $BASE_SHA)
```
Never take merge-base against the base branch tip for a merged PR: the branch is an ancestor of the tip, the merge-base is HEAD and the diff is empty. For a comment commit older than the final head, HEAD is that commit and BASE is its merge-base with base.sha. On PR 1920: base.sha b604cb860a; merge-base with 620d1e83ba = a85c91e3f5 (10 files in the diff); with 2d53016b44 = b604cb860a (8 files); `git merge-base 620d1e83ba origin/hwattention_sync` = 620d1e83ba (0 files).

Steps 1-8 are unchanged (probe exit above a formula assertion). On a `return;` found by step 9 whose owner line is an `if` on `available()` or getenv, continue with steps 1-8, not step 9.

9. Unconditional exits (trigger b). List added exits as HEAD file:line (the awk maps through the `@@` header):
   `git -C WT diff -U0 BASE HEAD -- 't/*.cpp' | awk '/^\+\+\+ /{f=substr($0,7)} /^@@/{split($3,a,/[,+]/); n=a[2]-1} /^\+/ && !/^\+\+\+/{n++; if ($0 ~ /^\+[[:space:]]*(return;|SKIP\()/) print f":"n": "substr($0,2)}'`
   For each hit print the owner line (nearest non-blank line above with smaller indentation):
   `awk -v L=<line> 'function ind(s){match(s,/^[ ]*/);return RLENGTH} {l[NR]=$0} END{h=ind(l[L]); for(i=L-1;i>0;i--){ if(l[i]~/^[ ]*$/)continue; if(ind(l[i])<h){print i": "l[i]; exit}}}' full/<file>`
   Proceed only when the owner line contains TEST_CASE, TEST_CASE_METHOD or SECTION(. An owner `if` on a hardware or environment probe is trigger (a). An owner `if constexpr`, `else`, `for`, `while`, a lambda or a free function (`static`, `template`, a return type at column 0) is a conditional exit or a helper and does not trigger (b).
   Unit bounds (end defaults to EOF for the last case of a file):
   `awk -v L=<line> 'NR<=L && /^TEST_CASE/{s=NR} NR>L && /^TEST_CASE/ && !e{e=NR} END{if(!e)e=NR+1; print s, e}' full/<file>`
   `sed -n '<line>,<e-1>p' full/<file> | grep -c -E '^[[:space:]]*(REQUIRE|CHECK)'` (assertions that no longer run; > 0 with no comment on the exit line = finding)
   `git -C WT log --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short -G'^  return;$' HEAD -- t/<file>` (whole history, anchored regex; the oldest hit is the adding commit, which can predate BASE; 'debug' or 'address PR feedback' subjects mark a leftover)
   `#if 0` blocks and `//`-commented assertions are not listed here; they belong to disabled-code-left-in.
   On PR 1920 (comment commit 620d1e83ba, BASE a85c91e3f5): the first awk prints exactly `t/t_hwattention.cpp:670:   return;`; owner line :603 `TEST_CASE_METHOD(fixture, "save_k_and_v_to_hardware", "[save_k_and_v_to_hardware]")`; unit bounds 603 764; REQUIRE(mismatch_count == 0) at :725 and :755 (count 2); no comment on :670; added by 11cbfa723a (2026-01-24, 'PRep for merge of accessor chjange'), removed by 5fc70b31c4 (2026-01-28, 'address PR feedback'); absent at the final head 2d53016b44.
   On silent PR 4353 (HEAD a9a9cf30a4, BASE eeb72c0348): the first awk prints `t/t_llama_unit.cpp:2661:     return;`; owner line :2502 `if constexpr (split_queries) {` inside the helper check_page_range_reductions (:2198); no finding. The draft's two-or-four-space indentation variant fires here; the owner rule does not.

10. Selection gates (trigger c):
   `git -C WT diff -U0 BASE HEAD -- 't/*.cpp' | grep -E '^[-+].*TEST_CASE[_A-Z]*\(' | paste - -` (pair the `-` and `+` lines by test name; a pair whose only difference is a `.` after `[` is a hidden-tag change)
   `git -C WT diff -U0 BASE HEAD -- t/CMakeLists.txt | grep -n -E '^-.*add_(catch_)?test'`
   `grep -n -E '"\[\.' full/<file>` (pre-existing hidden tags: a file where every slow case is hidden is a pattern, a single new dot is a typo)
   `grep -n -i -E 'disable|hidden|\[\.' body.md log.txt` (discard a hit whose sentence names debug output, logging or a build option rather than a test: PR 1920 subject 'Disables the debug outputs by default')
   `git -C WT show HEAD:t/CMakeLists.txt | grep -n -E '<binary>|LABELS fpga|min_slices|DISABLED'` (list under selection, not a finding)
   On PR 2011 (comment commit c2d72e6a7f, BASE ab75e61d83): the pair at diff lines 56/57 reads `"[save_k_and_v_to_hardware]"` / `"[.save_k_and_v_to_hardware]"` at t/t_hwattention.cpp:500 (on that line only the dot changes; the same commit also renames ainput to ainput_bf16 in another hunk); pre-existing `"[.stream_k_and_v]"` at :659 (one hidden case, not a pattern); body and the six commit subjects name no disabling; t/CMakeLists.txt:158-159 register t_hwattention and t_hwattention_replay with RESOURCE_LOCK fpga LABELS fpga (selection); restored at d4795f37a5:500 by 'reenable test I typoed' (20:38:08Z), approved 20:39:02Z.

11. Fake boundary (trigger d). Open the TEST_CASE in full/<file> and name the first production call after the unit's own setup (PR 4128: `sh->xfer_gofs`). Follow it:
   `git -C WT grep -n '<call>' HEAD -- h/ src/` (to the function that takes a device or DmaQueue argument; that is the entry point)
   `git -C WT show HEAD:src/pos/fake.cpp | grep -n -A12 '<entry>('` (parameters with no name, or a one-line `return {...}`, are discarded). If this grep is empty, the test binary links the real driver and (d) does not apply (PR 1920 at 2d53016b44: xfer_blocks is only in src/pos/driver.cpp:729).
   `git -C WT show HEAD:src/pos/fake.cpp | awk '/^[A-Za-z_].* [a-z_0-9:]+\(/{name=$0; n=NR} /^  return \{[^}]*\};$/{if (NR-n<16) print n": "name}'` (every fake whose body is a bare return; at 97de6ee02c: k_hwcacheblock::xfer :201, v_hwcacheblock::xfer :207, get_devices_v1 :258, xfer_blocks :324, xfer_n_blocks :336, no noise)
   `git -C WT show HEAD:src/pos/fake.cpp | grep -n -E '^[[:space:]]+[A-Za-z_:<>]+( const)?\*?( const)?(,|\) noexcept \{)$'` (unnamed parameter lines; at 97de6ee02c :326-331 and :338-345)
   `git -C WT diff -U0 BASE HEAD -- t/<file> | grep -E '^[-+].*(REQUIRE|CHECK)'` (new assertions; drop a `+` line whose `-` twin differs only by the PR's rename map, check 10's rule: PR 3756 at 7206e88cc2 re-spells `queues[0]` as `queues[process_device_id{0}]` six times in t/t_dma_tracker.cpp)
   `sed -n '<s>,<e>p' full/<file> | grep -n -E 'push_back\(|gof_in_shard|base_tok_ix|index'` (index values; all zero = nonzero start, partial window and page boundary absent)
   For each discarded argument write the production break that changes it (wrong base, wrong fetcher, wrong length, off-by-one index) and check whether any listed assertion changes.
   On PR 4128 (comment commit 97de6ee02c): src/pos/fake.cpp:336-346 `xfer_n_blocks(PosDevice*, DmaQueue* q, hbm_address_t const*, size_t const*, uint8_t const* const*, size_t const*, size_t, bool, bool, uint32_t)` with body `return {q, 0, 0, nullptr, 0};`; declared h/libpos.hpp:533, hardware body src/pos/driver.cpp:1144, called at src/tron/gof.cpp:216 (inside shard::xfer_gof, the singleton path, :175) and :412 (inside shard::xfer_gofs, :222, the batch path the new cases call); the cases assert t/t_phase1_integration.cpp:912 `result.batch->size`, :916 `result.descriptor_count`, :917 `v_gather_calls`, :931/:940/:958 `packed[...]` bits, :1004-1014 the same kinds; indices from `indices.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(gi))` with gi from 0 (:904-906); a wrong base, fetcher or length changes none of these. At the head 7f80aa17da fake.cpp:376-396 names bases, fetchers, qdatas, qlens, nblocks and, under fake_dma_capture_enabled (:147), pushes `{dev->idx, bases[i], fetchers[i], bytes}` (:386-394, bare return at :395); t_phase1_integration.cpp:1072 'coalesced GOFs preserve singleton DMA destinations and bytes' reads it through `fake_dma_capture_guard` (:790).

12. Stale artifacts (trigger e). Added lines only:
   `git -C WT diff -U0 BASE HEAD -- 't/*.cpp' 't/*.hpp' | grep -n -E '^\+.*(ofstream|fopen\(|create_directories|"/tmp/|for_agent/|\.json")'` (map each to HEAD through the `@@` header)
   For each added fixed name: `grep -n -F '<name>' full/<file>` (a later `std::ifstream` or read helper on the same name is the read-back; a name written and never read is listed, not a hit)
   `grep -n -E 'remove\(|unlink|remove_all|temp_directory_path|mkstemp|getpid' full/<file>` (0 hits with a fixed-name read-back = finding)
   `git -C WT grep -n '<writer helper>' HEAD -- h/ src/` then `git -C WT show HEAD:<writer file> | grep -n -A3 'std::ofstream out('` (does the writer truncate and only log on open failure; narrows, does not close)
   On PR 1920 (head 2d53016b44, BASE b604cb860a): the added-line grep returns 13 hits in t/t_hwattention_replay.cpp (new file, +880 -0), among them :124 `"/tmp/k_cache_round_trip_dump.json"` written by `dump_k_cache_from_hbm(..., dump_file)` at :125 and read at :129 `std::ifstream dump_in(dump_file)` with REQUIRE(dump_in.is_open()) at :130; :229/:234 the V twin; :582-583 `for_agent/hw_output_iter{:02}.json` via std::ofstream (written, never read: listed only); the cleanup grep returns 0 hits; the writer is h/pos/hwattention.hpp:749, opens at :760 with `std::ios::trunc` and :761-762 only logs spdlog::error on failure (same pattern :886, :1012, :1089), so a failed write leaves the previous run's file for :129 to read.

The full-file variant fires on them; the added-line variant does not.

13. State the five facts: compiles on the lane; selected (tags, labels, add_catch_test, DISABLED); reachable (no exit above the assertion, conditional or not); observes the quantity the defect changes (not a fake's sink or a previous run's file); a log shows execution. For (b), (c) and (e) the facts reduce to selected and reachable; the lane fact comes from check 7. To establish the lane:
   `git -C WT ls-tree --name-only HEAD README.ci.md` (runner table when present; otherwise use the job `runs-on` labels in the workflow)
   `for f in $(git -C WT ls-tree --name-only HEAD .github/workflows/); do echo $f; git -C WT show HEAD:$f | sed -n '/^on:/,/^jobs:/p' | grep -n -A2 -E 'pull_request|push|merge_group'; done`
   `gh api repos/positron-ai/tron/commits/HEAD/check-runs --jq .total_count`
   A branches filter that omits the PR's base branch, plus total 0, means 'no lane gates this PR'; write that fact, not Insufficient data. On PR 1920: README.ci.md absent at 2d53016b44; cmake-single-platform.yml triggers on branches [main] only, build job runs-on `[self-hosted, fpga_01.05.03, test]` (:114), `ctest -LE fpga` :213 and `ctest -L fpga` :219; check-runs total 0 at 2d53016b44 and 620d1e83ba. On PR 4557 the existing step 8 line stays at 96a6220ab6 (the comment's commit_id moved to c5d44bd86f, where the comparison already sits at t_llama_unit.cpp:3693).

0. Editor instruction. Section 3 of SKILL.md becomes two labelled sub-parts: 3A the test cannot observe the defect (this item), 3B the run was not done (item tests-run-at-head-before-approve). Do not interleave their triggers.

2. Words used here. Change the BASE definition to: "BASE: `git merge-base HEAD <base.sha>` with base.sha from `gh api repos/<org>/<repo>/pulls/N --jq .base.sha`; never the base branch tip of a merged PR (the merge-base is then HEAD and the diff is empty)." Add: "Hidden tag: a Catch2 tag that starts with `.` (`[.name]` or `[.]`); the default run skips the case. Fake: the no-hardware implementation of the device entry points in src/pos/fake.cpp, built into test binaries on runners without an FPGA. Owner line: the nearest non-blank line above a statement with smaller indentation; it names the construct the statement belongs to."

3. Trigger. Replace the existing trigger sentence with the five-part trigger of the skill_entry, in full: "(a) Probe exit: a test adds a runtime assertion that compares stored bytes or indices with a literal table or a formula written out in the test, and between the TEST_CASE start and that assertion stands a runtime exit (`return`, SKIP, WARN plus return) conditioned on a hardware or environment probe (`available()`, a cpuinfo flag, FPGA presence, getenv). (b) Unconditional exit: an added `return;` or `SKIP(` whose owner line is the TEST_CASE, TEST_CASE_METHOD or SECTION line, with at least one REQUIRE or CHECK between it and the end of the unit at HEAD. An owner `if` on a probe is (a); an owner `if constexpr`, `else`, loop, lambda or free function does not trigger. (c) Selection gate: a TEST_CASE or TEST_CASE_METHOD tag string gains a leading `.`, `[.]` or `[!mayfail]`, or an add_catch_test line leaves t/CMakeLists.txt, and no PR-body or commit sentence says the test is being disabled. A min_slices_N, fpga or DISABLED TRUE registration is selection; list it. (d) Fake boundary: a new assertion (no `-` twin under the rename map) observes a count, a size or sampled staging bytes while the production call under test passes addresses, fetchers, offsets or lengths to an entry point whose fake implementation has unnamed parameters or a one-line `return {...}` body. (e) Stale artifact: the diff adds a line naming a fixed path (`/tmp/...`, or a relative directory such as `for_agent/`) that the test or a helper it calls writes, and the file at HEAD later opens the same name for reading, with no remove, unlink, remove_all or unique name between runs. A writer line present at BASE does not trigger."

Append the (b), (c), (d), (e) paragraphs from the skill_entry procedure, expanded as in procedure_commands steps 9-12 (owner line, unit bounds, `git log -G` over the whole history, `-`/`+` tag pairs, debug-output hits discarded, fake entry point with the no-fake exit clause, rename-map exclusion, added-line artifact grep with writer-helper location).

For (b), (c) and (e) the facts reduce to selected and reachable. When no workflow triggers on the PR's base branch and check-runs total 0, write 'no lane gates this PR'; write `Insufficient data` only for a runner capability or a log that is unavailable."

6. Do not fire. Keep the existing sentence and add the do_not_fire list of the skill_entry verbatim (hidden tag at BASE, bench or stress tag, comment-stated reason at t/t_weight_load_reuse.cpp:328-330 c5d44bd86f; whole binary with LABELS fpga, min_slices_N or DISABLED TRUE; opt-in getenv mode inside it, PR 2475 t/t_clearhbm.cpp:233 and :264-265 at dfbacb4754; recording fake, fake.cpp:376-396 at 7f80aa17da; conditional exit whose comment names the covering test; `return;` owned by `if constexpr`, a loop or a helper, PR 4353 t/t_llama_unit.cpp:2661 at a9a9cf30a4; `#if 0` and commented-out assertions belong to disabled-code-left-in; writer line present at BASE, PRs 1985 and 3756; silent test-only PRs 1978 and 1985 (mcherba, hwattention_sync), 2475 (bham0n, hwattention_sync), 2939 (nyanamaddi-positron, main), and the t/CMakeLists.txt-only RESOURCE_LOCK PR 2844 (hvaneenoo-positron, main); never ask the author to run the suite as the remedy, never claim to have run it).
